    • getConstructibleEquipmentTypes

      public static List<String> getConstructibleEquipmentTypes()
      Lists concrete equipment class names that can be constructed through the generic (String name) factory path.

      The list is discovered recursively from the runtime classpath, so newly added equipment is included without changing this factory. Specialized aliases and enum-only factory entries are not included because they do not identify additional concrete classes.

      Returns:
      immutable alphabetically sorted list of constructible simple class names

    • getSupportedEquipmentTypes

      public static List<String> getSupportedEquipmentTypes()
      Lists canonical equipment type names supported by createEquipment(String, String) without additional constructor context.

      This combines recursively discovered classes with enum-backed types such as DistillationColumn that use specialized construction. Context-dependent equipment, such as an Ejector requiring two inlet streams, is excluded.

      Returns:
      immutable alphabetically sorted list of name-only factory-supported types

    • createByClassName

      private static ProcessEquipmentInterface createByClassName(String name, String equipmentType)
      Reflection fallback that creates any concrete process equipment class exposing a (String name) constructor, located by its class name within the known equipment sub-packages. This guarantees that every current and future equipment class is constructible by name (and therefore through JsonProcessBuilder) without an explicit EquipmentEnum entry. The simple class name is matched case-sensitively; whitespace, underscore, and dash separators are stripped before probing.
      Parameters:
      name - the name to assign to the created equipment
      equipmentType - the equipment class name, e.g. "ControlValve"
      Returns:
      the created equipment, or null if no matching class with a (String) constructor was found
